1. Publish an owner-approved real travel film or Short to YouTube. Use a specific truthful topic/title, readable real thumbnail, useful description linking to the matching site story, corrected captions, chapters where helpful and appropriate playlists. There are currently no visible public uploads to optimise; do not fabricate video metrics or automatically publish the launch asset.
2. Keep the same public brand and website link on the owner's Instagram/TikTok profiles. These profiles were linked, not edited in this batch.
3. After approved website release, request crawling only for genuinely changed important canonical pages and allow processing time. Monitor Search Console queries, coverage and real Core Web Vitals; no usable field score was available in the current overview.
4. Bing Webmaster Tools offers another free discovery channel, but no account/property is verified here. An import/access grant needs the owner's participation; never invent a verification token or grant access silently.
5. Improve the Philippines written article and ongoing Field Notes using owner-supplied material. Do not bulk-create thin pages or duplicate Polarsteps content automatically.
6. Video watch-page/VideoObject work needs real video publication dates and suitable watch-page content. Image/author metadata must describe actual public media. Do not add invented timestamps to satisfy rich-result requirements.
7. No paid backlink packages, fake visits/subscribers, guarantees, public private contact details, unsupported Indexing API calls or automatic marketing emails for this maintenance release.
